author: MonkeySlap
body:
Mostly I want to know why using capital letters is "Punishable". When I ask mods about it, they say it's rude and/or obnoxious. However, what the hell else do you have on your side to express emotion? Anger. Desperation. Annoyance. These emotions need to be expressed. But how? All you have is !!!, ???. That's it. You can't bold text, Italicize it, or underline it like you can on the Forums. So how the hell else do you express emotion? I do agree that

"NoobPlayer666: WHOA LOOK AT THAT HAHAHAAH IM THE GREATEST HAHAHAAAAHH I DONT BELIVE THIS IM THE GREETEST I WATCH FUTURAMA WHOAOAAAAOOAOAOAOAOOA GG I CANT DO IT OMG LOVE IT GGG HAHHAHAHAHAHA WHOOO CAPS I LOVE FUTURAL EXPRESSION WHOOOO 1ST AMENDMENT, BITCHES YEAAAAA I CANT BELIEVE THIS HAHAHHAH"

Should be considered "Excessive Caps", because that is excessive. But

"AvicusNetworkGG: YES!!! I CAN'T BELIEVE I BROKE THAT CORE!!!"

or

"VermillionGym: HOW COULD YOU BREAK THAT BUTTON?"

or even

"Excitedkid5336: AHAHAHHAHA YES!!! SNOW DAY!!!"

should not be considered "Excessive" as you can see, AvicusNetworkGG is expressing happiness, disbelief, joy, etc.
VermillionGym is expressing anger, disbelief, annoyance, aggravation

Excitedkid5336 is obviously expressing Excitement and happiness.

Any usual staff member would immediately say "Watch the caps, <Name>", or even warn them if this continues.

I don't understand this. These players are trying to express emotion, but NoobPlayer666 is expressing no emotion, and no point. Only screaming pointless sentences. That is excessive. However, those three players are expressing emotion. There's a huge difference. Saying "How could you break that button?" is not the same as "HOW COULD YOU BREAK THAT BUTTON????"

Halting emotion is borderline Facism. I don't believe that you should be "censoring" all sentences, especially because there's no options to express emotion. I believe you should change your "Caps Policy" to what I'm saying above

Please consider and get back to me soon. I want to see your side of this.
-MonkeySlap
#MonkeyForStaff

title: I want to know more about the Caps Policy

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
I think it all depends. We have guidelines in regards to moderating, and chat infractions, but there is of course that area where it's up to the moderator's judgement.

Due to this, it's often hard to have one set rule on what or what not is punished for. In all cases however, it would matter how maybe times the person has used caps as well. If someone is using caps for every single message, then that's excessive.

We aren't trying to prevent emotions, we're just trying to get those annoying people to stop being annoying.

PS: I don't think there's a rule anywhere that prevents you from making an entire thread in bold.
